scope: frozen SIGReg pair-specificity audit; no optimizer, updates, training, or generation

configuration.readout: k=0 final source EOS and final target EOS
configuration.jepa_loss: raw symmetric mean squared endpoint distance
configuration.sigreg: exact Epps-Pulley; 17 knots [0,3], 1024 fresh random unit slices per call; source/target statistics independently averaged
configuration.audit_activity: conditioned on an active auxiliary step; no Bernoulli dropout sampling
configuration.projection_seed_scheme: 104729 + 1009*batch_index + draw_index; fresh per batch/draw and common across checkpoints
configuration.stochastic_model_behavior: train mode for gradient semantics; all Dropout and attention_dropout set to zero
configuration.endpoint_execution: verified source/target-only LlamaModel path; independent native row and unused vocabulary logits omitted

sign_convention: For theta' = theta - eta*g_objective, the first-order metric change is Delta metric = -eta*(g_metric dot g_objective). Positive reported descent effect therefore means the objective step increases that metric.
